sources.title: NIST SP 800-63-4 — Digital Identity Guidelines
sources.scope: Proofing, authentication and federation are separate trust services; this CLI does not implement them.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-63B-4 — Authentication and Authenticator Management
sources.scope: General authentication requirements and assurance levels; possession of a local HMAC key does not attest human identity.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-63C-4 — Federation and Assertions
sources.scope: Identity-provider assertions require a verified federation trust relationship; arbitrary ticket strings are not identity proof.
